content.json:
# File Replication — Operations
Pure → Azure Files mirror health. Set the time range above (default last 7 days).

content.query:
Event
| where EventLog == 'Application' and Source == 'FileRepl' and EventID in (1000,1001)
| top 1 by TimeGenerated desc
| extend J = parse_json(extract(@'(\{.*\})', 1, RenderedDescription))
| project ['Last run']=TimeGenerated, Status=tostring(J.Status), ExitCode=toint(J.ExitCode), DurationSec=toint(J.DurationSec), FilesCopied=toint(J.FilesCopied), FilesFailed=toint(J.FilesFailed), Purged=toint(J.FilesExtra)
content.title: Most recent run

content.query:
Event
| where EventLog == 'Application' and Source == 'FileRepl' and EventID in (1000,1001)
| summarize LastCompletion = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend MinutesSinceLastRun = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastCompletion) * -1
content.title: RPO lag (minutes since last completion)

content.query:
Event
| where EventLog == 'Application' and Source == 'FileRepl' and EventID == 1000
| extend J = parse_json(extract(@'(\{.*\})', 1, RenderedDescription))
| project TimeGenerated, DurationSec=toint(J.DurationSec), FilesCopied=toint(J.FilesCopied), Purged=toint(J.FilesExtra)
| render timechart
content.title: Trend — duration, files copied, files purged

content.query:
Event
| where EventLog == 'Application' and Source == 'FileRepl' and EventID in (1001,1002)
| extend J = parse_json(extract(@'(\{.*\})', 1, RenderedDescription))
| project TimeGenerated, EventID, Detail=RenderedDescription
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Failures and delete-canary events
